findings.before: Without explicit local opt-in the original tests could inherit the application database and cleanup by broad prefixes.
findings.status: Source correction reread; root owns executed verification
findings.after: Tests skip without OBLIGON_TEST_DATABASE_URL, reject non-local targets before connection, import app DB only after unique schema setup, and drop only the owned schema.

findings.before: SUDO_WEBHOOK_SECRET was wrongly exempted from sensitive configured-value scanning.
findings.status: Source correction reread; root owns executed verification
findings.after: Public exemption removed, synthetic secret/public configuration classification regression added. No actual secret leakage inferred.

findings.status: Root source correction inspected; fresh root suite verification pending
findings.detail: Negative source assertion slices around absent creditWalletOnce instead of current applyLedgerEntry principal credit, permitting an empty slice.
findings.after: Requires the transition and applyLedgerEntry posting to exist, then asserts stored principal and excludes fee/charged credit.

findings.status: Root correction source reviewed; actual affected HTTP63-case green recorded
findings.detail: Existing pagination assertions are source-presence checks and do not establish finite integer/date query handling; current Infinity/date hazards identified in partner route source.
findings.after: Validated bound pagination and dates, parameterized SQL and created_at/id ordering; signed partner HTTP fixtures reject invalid input400 and preserve stable scoped list/export200.

findings.detail: Fake push auth key decodes to 32 bytes instead of current 16-byte contract. Manual script not executed; not a failing automatic test claim.
Request helper drops provided webhook headers; wrong-header probe repeats missing-header request. Simulated branch expects ten times its stated top-up principal. Manual script not executed.

withdrawnConcerns.detail: An initial early-return concern was withdrawn after reading activeProvider guard before pending COUNT. A non-null user reaches the relevant configuration guard.
